# Third-party assets

`alpine.min.js` is Alpine.js 3.17.4 (https://alpinejs.dev), MIT licensed
(https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine/blob/main/LICENSE.md). Vendored as-is so
the panel needs no CDN and no build step; do not edit this file, update it by
replacing it with a newer release's `dist/cdn.min.js`.
